Well assembled with all the necessities including a refrigerator, full beds stocked with clean sheets and a front porch. Price consists of two people/night. An additional $15.00/person will be charged/night if more than two. Begley’s Campground is located in ATV friendly New Straitsville, Ohio with direct access to the Wayne National Forest OHV trail system.
